text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Rice
Shower...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-umm... do you see the claw machine
over
there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She points toward a claw machine filled
with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there are plushies of all my
friends in
there. I'm a little curious...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's trying to show restraint, but she
has an
obvious twinkle in her eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My bad luck might rub off on you... But
I'll cheer
you on!
